messages:
incident-bot: :rotating_light: Alert — decode tail latency elevated in us-east-1 for model redwood-13b-quant. Metric snapshot: decode_p99=2.18s (SLO 0.8s). Streaming frame drop rate +15%. Affected endpoint: /v1/generate (streaming). Dashboards: https://internal.metrics/model/redwood-13b-quant | Traces: https://traces/INC-2026-0713

alina: I'm here. Did anything land in the compile/runtime this morning? @rami you oncall?

rami: oncall here. We pushed a canary earlier with TRT 8.8.x and a FlashAttention shim (PR #4150) plus new compile flags. Suspect the new decode kernels.

sara: Support reports three customers with interrupted streaming and partial responses. UX degradation only during streaming. Not yet a Sev1 but SLO breaches happening. Looping CSMs now.

mike: quick root-level checks: GPU mem/SM utilization normal. Kernel tracing shows disproportionate time in decode path. KV cache rates unchanged. p95 rising to ~1.5s, p99 ~2.1–2.2s.

devops-bot: Detected build artifact runtime-compile-2026-03-14-v4 containing define ENABLE_FLASH_ATTENTION_FUSED and updated TRT libs.

alina: mitigation brainstorm: 1) route streaming traffic to legacy build, 2) runtime env to disable fused flash-attn, 3) fallback to non-streaming responses, 4) rollback compile bundle. Which is fastest?

jiao: I can apply a routing override. Recommend 60% -> legacy and 40% -> current to reduce blast radius while validating.

rami: I'll queue a rollback for the compile artifact. Also request a quick flag toggle test: `REDWOOD_ENABLE_FLASHATTN=false` on a tiny slice.

mike: flame-summary from perf capture:
```
decode_v4_kernel    65% (baseline 12%)
flash_attn_wrapper  17%
memcpy_async         10%
other                 8%
```
decode_v4 kernel dominates now; flash_attn wrapper present in stacks.

jiao: routing override committed: streaming /v1/generate -> 60% legacy (redwood-13b-quant-v1), 40% current. Changes are live.

incident-bot: :white_check_mark: Routing override applied by jiao. Observed immediate improvement on routed traffic segments.

alina: mike, flip `REDWOOD_ENABLE_FLASHATTN=false` for a 10% slice and report p99 for that slice.

mike: flag flipped. That slice p99 dropped to ~0.7s within a minute. Remaining slice stayed ~2.1s. Strong causal signal.

rami: rollback job for runtime-compile-2026-03-14-v4 queued and executing in us-east-1.

devops-bot: rollback/runtime-compile-2026-03-14-v4 initiated by rami.

sara: status update: posting to status page and contacting affected customers. No data loss reported; timeouts/retries observed. CSMs looped.

mike: compile flags of interest in v4: `-O3 -fuse-ld=gold -march=skylake-avx512 -mavx512f -DENABLE_FLASH_ATTENTION_FUSED`. The fused macro likely toggles an alternate decode code path that increases register pressure.

rami: rollback complete in us-east-1, reverting to runtime-compile-2026-03-07 baseline.

devops-bot: rollback/runtime-compile-2026-03-14-v4 completed (cluster us-east-1).

incident-bot: Observability: decode_p99 trending down to ~0.79s after rollback; streaming stall rate decreased ~88%.

sara: updated status page with mitigation message and emailed affected workspace owners. Recording SLA impact for billing reconciliation.

jiao: put canary on hold and created ticket RED-INC-0713-RB to track revert and re-land plan. No re-land until perf validation and golden tests pass.

mike: uploading flamegraphs, perf traces, and compiler build logs to the incident ticket INC-2026-0713. Hypothesis: fused attention path increased spills/branch divergence on decode kernels, causing disproportionate tail latency under streaming concurrency.

rami: applied temporary global flag in us-east-1 `REDWOOD_ENABLE_FLASHATTN=false` until postmortem completes.

incident-bot: Pager handoff -> @nina for overnight watch. Incident ticket: https://incidents/INC-2026-0713 | Postmortem template: https://wiki/postmortems

nina: acknowledged. I'll run the streaming smoke/regression suite against the rollback image tonight and monitor decode_p95/p99 and frame drop alerts.

alina: postmortem owner: alina. Action items assigned:
- alina: write postmortem and RCA (due 72h)
- mike: attach perf artifacts and build logs (due 24h)
- rami: ensure rollback pins and deploy locks are committed (done)
- jiao: coordinate re-land gating and add golden streaming test (due 48h)

support-bot: queued email notifications to workspace owners (3).

sara: no new customer escalations in the last 20m. Marking incident state: mitigated -> monitoring. Reopen if any regressions.

mike: note for postmortem: reproduce with identical toolchain (clang/gcc versions), compile flags, and run streaming decode stress harness to observe register spill behavior and verify which codegen pattern causes spike.

alina: great response team. Schedule a 10:30 follow-up to review artifacts and finalize re-land gating criteria.

nina: monitoring configured: tighter thresholds on decode_p95/p99 and streaming frame drop rate for next 48h.
